claimBoundary: Registers only source-verified modules. Statuses describe current implementation and executable evidence, not roadmap intent.

modules.name: Historical Import API
modules.description: Tenant-scoped historical TOS/PL.03 import with cumulative-snapshot replacement, safe partial merge, Admin-only inactive-history deletion and one PL.03 row per Berth call; local browser and PostgreSQL evidence are recorded while production evidence remains outside scope.

modules.name: Activity Reports API
modules.description: Activity analytics and Excel exports support explicit LIVE, historical/TOS and overlap-protected combined sources for PL.02/PL.03, while PL.01 remains LIVE-only; historical analytics also filters by normalized Berth column H. Local rendered-browser evidence is recorded while production evidence remains outside scope.

modules.name: User Management API
modules.description: Platform-admin user, operations-summary, and local-backup API routes extracted from app.py.

modules.name: Vessels API
modules.description: Reporting-unit, port-register and vessel API, including quarantined vessel attachments; the prior route extraction is enforced while new attachment PostgreSQL evidence remains pending.
